notes.text: Sichardt radius of influence is shown as a screening estimate only. It is not a permit-grade hydrogeological prediction.

Hydraulic screening uses a transmissivity profile through the pumped interval: T = Σ(k_h · b). For unconfined flow, the radial drawdown is solved from the cumulative transmissivity moment rather than from one lumped k_h value.
Aquifer base was not provided, so the CPT bottom depth is used as a first-pass aquifer base. Verify this against geology or pumping-test data.
Total-stress mode sensitivity is negligible for this case: conservative = 36.83 mm, realistic = 36.83 mm. The pore-pressure reduction dominates the result here.
